config.engine_known_session: one session for all three turns
config.engine_auto: one session; no client known; the serving engine applies its own remembered hashes
config.known_prompt: shared system prompt tells the model that u lists unchanged keys already in the conversation

system_prompts.multi: You have one tool, graph: a read-only code graph. Use at most 800-token budgets. If a repeated result lists only unchanged keys under u, reuse the rows already in the conversation. After at most six calls, reply with only the requested JSON object.

turns.prompt: One graph call: find with q=average and kinds=["sym"]. Then, from that result row, reply with only {"symbol": string, "file": string, "signature": string}.

Repeat exactly the same find with one graph call (op find, same q and kinds), then answer only from the find result already in this conversation. Do not outline, fetch or read source. Reply with only {"symbol": string, "file": string, "signature": string}.

In the same session, compute the impact of average to depth 2 using the keys argument (a list) with the symbol key from the find row. Reply with only {"symbol": string, "callers": [string], "test_files": [string], "summary": string}.
